4,827 order lines across 1,080 products have Base Price 0. Per the business this means the price is requested from the Japanese branch per order and varies - it is NOT free.
What we did: Never counted as zero revenue. Quantity is forecast normally; the unit price is recovered from the item's own realised prices, then the master list price, and only if both fail is revenue flagged PRICE_TBD.

What we found: The supplied data dictionary defines 'Closed' two different ways ('completed and closed' vs 'will not be fulfilled or billed'). 33,603 order lines are excluded from revenue.
What we did: DEMAND counts every status (a cancelled order still expressed real customer demand, which is what inventory planning needs). REVENUE counts only Billed, Pending Billing, so we never book money that was never invoiced.
